records.query: book reading tracker local no account
records.problem: I want to track books I am reading and have read, with progress and ratings stored in IndexedDB or localStorage, plus export/import, and absolutely no cloud account.
solutionWeaknesses: cloud accounts and social graphs required
recommendation noise around a simple shelf
userFailures: Clearing site data wipes the shelf because export was never offered until after the loss.
Import of a CSV silently drops ratings when the header aliases do not match exactly.
A book marked 'finished' still appears in Currently Reading because status and progress disagree.
Duplicate entries appear after importing the same export twice with no merge-by-ISBN option.
